output.content: I was digging through the logs for the latest retraining run and noticed the usual pattern. The data prep scripts are sitting in a shared folder, and the actual training job only kicks off when someone manually triggers it from the command line. There is no automated schedule or dependency check to start the process once the nightly point of sale data lands. We are essentially waiting for a human to remember to run the pipeline every week. The last three cycles show timestamps that align perfectly with when a person logged in and typed the start command. It is a straightforward manual step in the current workflow, and the system does not initiate the training sequence on its own.
output.reclassify_reason: The text objectively describes the current manual workflow and log evidence without expressing any wishes, refusals, or stated needs for change.
